name: SOD Policy Violation Owner Notification
description: Sent to a user that is designated as an SoD policy violation owner or notification recipient.
subject: SoD Policy Violations Identified for $policyName
body:
SoD Policy Violation Notification

Dear $violationOwnerName,

You are receiving this email because you are designated as a Separation of Duties (SoD) policy violation owner or notification recipient. SoD policy violations have been identified within $__global.productName.

Violation details

  • Violation count: $violationCount
  • Risk level: $policyLevel
  • Policy name: $policyName
  • Description: $policyDescription
#if($policyExternalReference && $policyExternalReference.trim() != "")

External reference: $policyExternalReference

#end

If you are designated to manage violations for $policyName, you can do so from the $__global.productName Dashboard.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
